Flight · Germany

Two drones sighted over military installation in western Germany

7 August 2026 · Western Germany · site unspecified

Unresolved foreign involvement

On the night of 7–8 August 2026 two drones were seen above a military installation in western Germany. The precise site was not specified, and the sighting was reported on 8 August. The drones' launch points are unknown.

No foreign or Russian link has been established.

No damage or casualties were reported. Authorities investigated the overflight of the sensitive site.
